chatAskChapterPace: How is the pacing of this chapter?
chatAskMotives: Do the characters’ motivations make sense?
chatAskVolumePace: How is the pacing of this volume?
chatAttachChapterTip: {unit, select, word {Also send the chapter outline and about 2000 words before the cursor to the AI} other {Also send the chapter outline and about 2000 characters before the cursor to the AI}}
chatAttachVolumeTip: Also send the volume outline to the AI
chatAttachedAll: Attaches all {count, plural, one {# lore entry} other {# lore entries}}
chatAttachedAt: Attaches {count, plural, one {# lore entry} other {# lore entries}} as they were at “{chapter}”
chatAttachedOmitted: {count, plural, one {# lore entry attached to the reply; {omitted} omitted due to the context limit} other {# lore entries attached to the reply; {omitted} omitted due to the context limit}}
chatCapped: The lookup limit for this turn was reached. The answer above is based only on what was found.
chatCatalogNote: The catalog has only the category, name and first sentence. The AI looks up the full text when needed.
chatCrowded: Lore is long, so only the catalog is attached this time
chatDigestNote: The AI wrote this summary. If something is wrong, point it out in the chat.
chatDigestRounds: The earlier {count, plural, one {# round} other {# rounds}} condensed into a summary
chatFateAiOff: Discarded when AI was turned off
chatFateBookClosed: Discarded when the book was closed
chatFateChanged: The text changed; the proposal was voided
chatFixedTip: This chat uses the text and lore of this chapter
chatLocate: Find this passage in the text
chatMoreChanges: {count, plural, one {# more change} other {# more changes}} after this, not listed.
chatPartLoreCount: Lore: {count, plural, one {# entry} other {# entries}}
chatProposalMeta: {unit, select, word {{where} · {count, plural, one {# word} other {# words}} · {state}} other {{where} · {count, plural, one {# character} other {# characters}} · {state}}}
chatProposing: Proposing an edit in the text…
chatRoundRequests: This turn made {count, plural, one {# request} other {# requests}}. This is the last one.
chatTypeTopic: Type what you want to chat about
chatUnanswered: This message has no reply yet
chatUsageCached: Actual usage: {input} in, {cached} from cache, {output} out
dialogPicked: {unit, select, word {{count, plural, one {# word} other {# words}} selected} other {{count, plural, one {# character} other {# characters}} selected}}
dialogSourceAbout: Select a passage to add it to the text as confirmed lore. The original text won’t change.
draftBusyOther: AI is replying to another chat; wait for it to finish or cancel before you {action}.
helpCite: Quote the selected text in a chat
sideFoldedCount: {count, plural, one {# collapsed chat} other {# collapsed chats}}
talkContinueAbout: The AI will refer to the existing lore and text.
talkInputHint: Type an idea, or ask the AI…
talkNext1: What happens next in the plot?
talkNext3: Sort out the relationships between the characters
talkStart1: I want to write a city where it always rains
talkStart2: The protagonist has a secret they cannot say aloud
talkStart3: Where is the conflict in this story?
talkStartAbout: Write down a rough idea. The AI records what the chat settles in the lore document on the right, right away. Settled lore guides later chats; abandoned lore is no longer mentioned.
